tools.name: calculate_average_balance
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an average monthly balance calculator, a bank statement average balance, an average daily balance or proof of funds figures from their transactions. Put the statement rows into transactions (date, description, amount or credit/debit, running balance); convert pasted text

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: calculate_average_balance · Private data: calculate_average_balance · Public sink: calculate_average_balance.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: calculate_average_balance · Private data: calculate_average_balance · Public sink: calculate_average_balance

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
